messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Automated deploy finished to canary pool 'canary-3' for release/variant v2026-05-03-hotcut (weightset w-9832). Observability checks running, will report anomalies.
samir.k: seeing a spike in 5xx and a ton of garbled tokens in responses from canary-3. sample user log:\n```\nERROR tokenizer: mismatched vocab mapping for model v3.2. token_id=50213 -> <unk>\nrequest_id=3f9b2e\n```\nThis started ~30s after the deploy cut.
anna.li: ack, tagging oncall. Any customer-facing errors yet? :eyes:
ben.carter: taking oncall. paging the rotation. can you dump the canary metric heatmap (latency/5xx/token-errors) and the deploy manifest?
samir.k: heatmap: cpu ok, but token_error_rate ~12% on canary-3, global ~0.3%. Affected region: eu-west-1 primarily. Deploy manifest: `release:v2026-05-03-hotcut`, model_variant: v3.2.1, tokenizer_config: `tokenizer-config@sha:ab12cd` (but our prod canonical is `sha:9f88a7`).
maria.p: that tokenizer sha mismatch is config drift. The deploy used the staging tokenizer bundle by accident (CI tag mismatch). probable root: release pipeline allowed non-canonical tokenizer alias. we should kill the feature flag and fallback to previous weightset.
anna.li: flip feature flag `release-hotcut-enable` -> false (kill-switch) :lock: (rolling)
deploy-bot: feature flag `release-hotcut-enable` set to false for release/variant v2026-05-03-hotcut by anna.li. Autoscaling and routing adjusted to exclude canary-3.
pagerduty: Paging oncall: Incident triggered (tokenizer-mismatch-high) — assigned to ben.carter.
ben.carter: running rollback to prior known-good weightset w-9810 and tokenizer sha:9f88a7. command: `infra deploy rollback --target-weight w-9810 --tokenizer-sha 9f88a7 --scope canary-3`.
ben.carter: rollback initiated. ETA ~60s to cut traffic and warm caches.
samir.k: observed immediate drop in token_error_rate after initial routing changes, still watching for tail errors. customer error reports: 4 support tickets mentioning garbled output (EU customers), flagged at priority P2.
maria.p: putting an emergency validation job to re-check tokenizer mappings and regenerate tokenizer package before re-release. CI gating updated to require explicit tokenizer alias match.
deploy-bot: automated fallback activated: routing requests away from canary-3 to fallback pool. weightset w-9810 promoted in routing table. :white_check_mark:
ben.carter: rollback complete. canary-3 now serving w-9810 + tokenizer sha:9f88a7. 5xx and token error metrics returned to baseline. Confirming customer impact window: ~00:02:15 — ~00:06:40 UTC (roughly 4.5 minutes).
anna.li: good job. logging an immediate incident ticket to track follow-ups: postmortem, CI fix to prevent tokenizer alias drift, add canary preflight that checks tokenizer sha equality.
maria.p: I'll own the postmortem and the CI gating change. assigning follow-up tasks in tracker.
eng-oncall-bot: Handoff: ben.carter -> maria.p (day shift) at 6315554472. Please verify follow-ups and close when stable.
samir.k: verification: re-run synthetic prompt set against canary-3, all token outputs look correct now. closing monitoring loop.
anna.li: marking incident as mitigated. we'll keep an eye on support tickets; customer outreach if more reports come in. :handshake:
_meta: Generated Slack incident thread: bad model release with tokenizer config drift; includes incident bot posts, pagerduty paging, on-call coordination, feature-flag kill-switch, rollback, customer impact summary, and handoff.
